lines.speaker: Green
lines.text: Help me carry the flowers? The market has a little money left for hands that help.

lines.speaker: Seth
lines.text: You can hear the roof from here if you know which ledge to call from.

choices.label: Take the stair to the roof

lines.speaker: Blue
lines.text: I put the sign back the right way up. The long road is yours, unless you’d rather take the diner steps.

lines.speaker: Flowery
lines.text: What a climb! Take these while you can still see where they fall.

lines.speaker: Yellow
lines.text: You’ve got a table for two dice. Want the set, or the cash left under the plate?

lines.speaker: Aqua
lines.text: This valve fills the garden beds. Try it while I watch the gauge.
